scope: Publicly documented services for justice-impacted people; these are not employer-confirmed vacancies, job offers or guaranteed enrollments.

records.name: Center for Employment Opportunities — Columbus
records.summary: Direct employer-authored evidence of transitional employment services, job coaching and skills support for people recently released from incarceration.

records.name: Center for Employment Opportunities — Cleveland
records.summary: Official reentry employment program serving people recently released from incarceration. Verify program enrollment eligibility and capacity.

records.name: Center for Employment Opportunities — Cincinnati
records.summary: Official reentry employment services for people recently released from incarceration, with employment-readiness and coaching support.

records.name: Towards Employment — Community & Reentry
records.summary: Career readiness, coaching and connections to employers willing to hire people with records; training and support services described by provider.

records.name: EDWINS Leadership & Restaurant Institute
records.summary: Official tuition-free culinary/hospitality training enrollment for formerly incarcerated adults 18+. No previous culinary training needed; selection and class capacity still apply.

records.name: Cincinnati Works / Beacon of Hope
records.summary: Employer network and career coaching for people facing barriers; a documented second-chance hiring initiative. No particular partner role is guaranteed.

records.name: Goodwill Industries of Northwest Ohio — Reentry Services
records.summary: City of Toledo's official reentry guide lists this provider for job-focused support for people with criminal convictions.

records.name: Reentry Coalition of Northwest Ohio
records.summary: Official coalition website and municipal directory list employment, housing, referral and reentry navigation services; no placement promise.

records.name: Montgomery County Reentry Career Alliance Academy
records.summary: County-administered job-readiness academy and case management program for returning citizens, with referral opportunities to employers and services.

records.name: Lucas County CJCC Reentry Committee
records.summary: Public coordinating body for reentry organizations and services. This is a referral and partnership resource rather than a hiring program.

records.name: Urbean Cafe / Broken Chains Ministry Workforce Development
records.summary: Official Broken Chains Ministry page describes hands-on cafe work and workforce training for returning citizens in Akron. Current training placement or jobs are not confirmed.

records.name: South Street Ministries — Front Porch Reentry Support
records.summary: Community directory describes free reentry meetings, job readiness, peer support, housing referrals and cafe training when available. Verify current hours and capacity.

records.name: SOCHE Job Seeker Resources for Returning Citizens
records.summary: Official SOCHE job seeker page connects returning citizens to second-chance-focused employer resources, education and Montgomery County reentry support. This is a referral resource, not an individual vacancy.

records.name: Southeast Ohio Reentry Coalition
records.summary: Ohio reentry coalition listed in the ReLink directory for six southern Ohio counties. Find coalition and related county reentry resources; this is not an employer or guaranteed placement.
